# Release reading: turn a Qwen3-8B announcement into a qualified brief

Qwen’s dated 2025-04-29 announcement includes Qwen/Qwen3-8B as dense open weights (A). Do not turn the table’s 128K into a native limit: the exact card distinguishes native context from YaRN extension (B). 2025-05-14 is the family report v1 submission date (C), not a first-upload date established here. Listing and license evidence are visible (D/E), without establishing regional service access or deployment readiness.

- **Dates**: 2025-04-29: dated official announcement; 2025-05-14: report v1; 2026-11-01: lesson check. First upload remains unknown. [A/C]
